attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[],"voice":1,"clarity":3,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"The output copies the briefing's section headings (\"News since your last bulletin:\", \"Already reported:\") into the bulletin, which breaks character and labels old news openly; it also falls short of 80 words. The prose is flat and generic (\"a grim reminder of the dangers out here\"), with little of Tomas Quell's earnest, worried voice."}
